title: Navigation API: nullify ongoing navigate event on successful cross-document navigation
body: Currently per spec, setting the ongoing navigation to "traversal" would abort the `navigate` event and fire `navigateerror` (and abort the event's signal). However, tests like [this one](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/156bb7cbb8483f6ffd4b275a1ed0b628fd0582cc/navigation-api/ordering-and-transition/transition-cross-document.html#L25) say otherwise, and this is not implemented anywhere. In current implementations, the `ongoing navigate event` stays dangling, which creates unexpected results when the page is restored from BFCache - the abort signal and `navigateerror` events fired as a result of the next same-document navigation after being restored from BFCache. This change makes it so that a succesful "traversal" (cross-document navigation) nullifies the ongoing event and API method tracker, without "aborting" it, making it so that the navigation neither signals success or failure.
